visualCharacteristics: Adventure specifications sidebar. A vertical list of label/value pairs (e.g. Activity / Surfing), each row separated by a horizontal divider. Labels are uppercase and bold on the left; values align right.
contentPattern: One row per specification. Each row has two cells: a label cell and a value cell.
usage: Structured spec/attribute lists that recur identically across a set of detail pages (e.g. adventure specs).
